purpose: Close or rule out newly discoverable independent public raw data for the remaining IJHE validation gates without reusing an already opened holdout.

sources.title: JRC Reference Data from Experiments on Onboard Hydrogen Tanks Fast Filling
sources.data_type: full-scale hydrogen tank filling and emptying experiments
sources.access_observation: The JRC publication record describes a reference database, but its Datasets and Dataset collections fields contain no public machine-readable URL. The linked public material is a publication/figure record.
sources.blocking_reason: No rights-cleared pressure-temperature time-series export was available from the public record.

sources.title: JRC GasTeF experimental papers and facility records
sources.access_observation: The records document Type III/IV filling conditions and instrumentation, but do not expose a downloadable raw logger archive for a new frozen score.
sources.blocking_reason: A plotted range or paper figure cannot close the Type-III prospective temperature gate.

sources.title: H2-Stations European hydrogen refuelling station export API
sources.data_type: station metadata, availability, events and aggregate operational signals
sources.access_observation: The public API provides station and availability information; it does not provide synchronized pressure, temperature and mass-flow logger traces for a component holdout.
sources.blocking_reason: No raw process trace or apparatus boundary is available.

sources.title: DTU-TES Hydrogen-Fuelling-Station Modelica library
sources.access_observation: The repository contains Modelica components and property files, not independent measured pressure, temperature or release traces.
sources.blocking_reason: Simulation code cannot be counted as an external experimental validation dataset.

sources.title: Existing Light-Duty Hydrogen Refueling Stations In-Use Study Report
sources.data_type: operational study report and plotted station examples
sources.access_observation: The report contains station-use and fueling figures, but no rights-cleared common-clock station/controller/vehicle raw bundle was exposed in the public report.
sources.blocking_reason: It cannot close the station-side component holdout or the excluded station-to-vehicle full-loop gate.

sources.title: Experimental investigation and thermodynamic model improvement of the refueling process in type III and type IV hydrogen storage cylinders
sources.data_type: recent Type III/IV cylinder refueling experiments and thermodynamic model study
sources.access_observation: The public abstract and indexing records describe the experimental campaign and model results, but the publisher page is abstract-only in the available access path and no rights-cleared machine-readable pressure-temperature-time supplement or repository archive was found.
sources.blocking_reason: Reported aggregate/model results cannot close a prospective independent temperature-pressure holdout without the raw trace, channel dictionary and pre-outcome access order.

sources.title: Detection of hydrogen released in a full-scale residential garage
sources.data_type: full-scale hydrogen/forming-gas release with four sensor locations and time-response plots
sources.access_observation: The public conference PDF reports sensor layout, response times and plotted concentration histories for repeated garage experiments. It does not expose a machine-readable raw time-series table or explicit redistribution terms.
sources.blocking_reason: The source was opened after the frozen spatial-transfer protocol and its plotted/aggregate results cannot close the independent detector-placement holdout.

sources.title: H2SAFE, ELVHYS, USN open-channel and other current repository sources
sources.access_observation: These sources are already represented by frozen protocols and retained outcomes in the repository. Recounting them as new holdouts would violate the access-order rule.
sources.blocking_reason: Outcome access and prior diagnostics are already recorded.

sources.title: Hydrogen station in situ back-to-back fueling data for design and modeling
sources.data_type: one-year operational HRS fueling-event and station-response study
sources.access_observation: The article claims a comprehensive real-station dataset and reports pressure, cooling, thermodynamics and vehicle state-of-charge analyses. The publicly reachable article and institutional record expose the study description and plotted/aggregate results, but no rights-cleared machine-readable station/vehicle logger export or supplemental raw archive was found.
sources.blocking_reason: It cannot close a prospective synchronized station-to-vehicle holdout without raw channels, a variable dictionary and pre-outcome access order.

sources.title: Group B HySam system measurement data (MetHyTrucks)
sources.data_type: open sampling-system condition workbooks with pressure/temperature channels
sources.access_observation: The Zenodo record exposes three open XLSX files for hydrogen sampling-system tests. They describe sampling hardware conditions rather than a station-to-vehicle fueling loop and do not provide dispenser/receptacle/controller synchronization.
sources.blocking_reason: The files are useful boundary/context data but do not represent the HRS source-line-dispenser-vehicle system required by the frozen gates.

sources.title: Efficiency of mechanical ventilation on H2 dispersion (PS)
sources.data_type: open actual-hydrogen spatial concentration sheets, ventilation conditions and CAD facility context
sources.access_observation: The Zenodo record is open under CC BY 4.0 and exposes five XLSX workbooks with 41 hydrogen concentration worksheets, coordinate grids and declared ventilation conditions, plus a CAD archive. The archive is spatial/condition data rather than a common-clock HRS station or vehicle logger.
sources.blocking_reason: The archive was opened after the current spatial-detector analysis and is not time-resolved station data, so it cannot close the independent H2SAFE spatial-transfer gate or authorize runtime detector routing.

sources.title: First version of the H2 releases database (NHyRA WP1)
sources.data_type: public database assessment/report for hydrogen release experiments
sources.access_observation: The public PDF describes a planned/compiled release database and safety-data scope, but the accessed record did not expose a rights-cleared machine-readable pressure-temperature-mass-flow trace or a frozen case-level outcome bundle.
sources.blocking_reason: A database overview without reusable case-level raw traces cannot close an independent component holdout or station-to-vehicle validation gate.

sources.title: HyTunnel-CS open data repositories index
sources.data_type: public repository catalogue for hydrogen safety campaigns
sources.access_observation: The index confirms open repositories for Grüne ventilation, PRESLHY, pressure-peaking and tunnel campaigns; the listed records are already represented in the repository or lack synchronized HRS station/controller/vehicle channels.
sources.blocking_reason: A catalogue page is not a new raw holdout and cannot be counted again after outcome access.

sources.title: Quantitative analysis of hydrogen leakage and diffusion processes based on real-time concentration measurement at different spatial positions in a customized chamber
sources.data_type: actual-hydrogen chamber release measurements with 26 spatial concentration sensors
sources.access_observation: The article abstract reports repeated real-hydrogen releases, measured leakage flow, 26 sensor positions and time-resolved concentration behavior. The accessible publisher/index routes did not expose a rights-cleared machine-readable sensor-time-series export, coordinate file, calibration record or redistribution terms.
sources.blocking_reason: Without the raw sensor time series, coordinate crosswalk, release metadata and rights statement, this source cannot close the independent spatial-detector holdout. It can support a future pre-access custodian request only.

conclusion.next_action: Obtain a rights-cleared, previously uninspected Type-III temperature-pressure trace or a new independent pressure-decay/release campaign, then freeze the scoring protocol before opening outcomes.
conclusion.claim_boundary: The current study may report the existing bounded component results and retained negative findings, but may not claim full independent Type-III thermal, outdoor consequence-distance, spatial detector-transfer or station-to-vehicle validation.

search_round_2026_10_14_addendum.interpretation: The Cal State LA study is a strong real-operation reference but its public access path does not expose the raw synchronized logger bundle. HySam files are open measurements but are for sampling-system conditions, not a station-to-vehicle or station-side release holdout. The Grüne/PS archive adds actual-hydrogen spatial development evidence but not an independent station or detector-transfer holdout.

search_round_2026_10_14_second_pass.interpretation: The NHyRA document is a public database overview without an accessed case-level raw trace. The HyTunnel catalogue confirms repository coverage but adds no new uninspected station-side or station-to-vehicle raw bundle.

new_candidates_checked.observed: Official RADAR/B2FIND record exposes an open-access CC BY-SA 4.0 archive for E5.1 ignited discharge benchmarking.
new_candidates_checked.reason: The archive is already represented by the frozen PRESLHY E5.1 protocol/result in this repository; reusing it cannot create a new independent holdout or change the retained failure.

new_candidates_checked.observed: Publisher record describes the 431 bar blowdown and publishes a fitted pressure-history figure.
new_candidates_checked.reason: No rights-cleared machine-readable pressure-time logger export was found in the accessible record; the existing Schefer holdout remains failed.

new_candidates_checked.observed: KIT publication record confirms the 0.37 dm3, up-to-200 bar, 3/4/10 mm release campaign.
new_candidates_checked.reason: The record does not provide a rights-cleared raw pressure-time table; the existing figure-derived diagnostic remains non-promoted.

search_round_2026_10_14_third_pass.interpretation: This targeted third pass added no new eligible untouched raw trace. Existing source records reinforce the apparatus and license boundaries but do not justify changing a validation gate or runtime model.

new_candidates_checked.observed: The current NLR catalog record confirms five indoor experiments using helium surrogate, with sensor coordinates, source coordinates and time-series resources.
new_candidates_checked.reason: The DOI and five-case cohort match the existing H2SAFE candidate-development record; it is not actual-hydrogen evidence and cannot be counted as a new independent holdout.

new_candidates_checked.observed: The official record describes 25 liquid-hydrogen release experiments and an 11.3 GB CC BY-SA archive with pressure, mass-flow, temperature, concentration and weather channels.
new_candidates_checked.reason: One workbook from this archive was already accessed before a new prospective protocol, and the campaign is elevated liquid-hydrogen release rather than a gaseous HRS station-side or station-to-vehicle loop. It cannot close the current gaseous HRS gates without a separately frozen, unaccessed member and a claim-limited protocol.

search_round_2026_10_14_fourth_pass.interpretation: The fourth pass confirms that the newly indexed NLR entry is the already-used helium cohort and that PRESLHY E3.5 is a valuable liquid-hydrogen consequence source but does not provide a new gaseous HRS holdout under the current access history. No gate, runtime parameter or progress percentage is changed.
